headline: PIT @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 4.19 at STL 4.49, with a projected total of 8.67. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward STL: PIT moved -0.08 runs while STL moved +0.81, changing the projected margin by -0.89 runs. The projected total climbed +0.74, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +14.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Dustin May has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Horwitz, Konnor Griffin, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags José Fermín, Oneil Cruz because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
